row.category: Vertical SaaS (Healthcare, Education, Real Estate, Construction, Field Service)
row.evidence: JLL's Prism by Building Engines page says the platform has "Single Sign-On (SSO) support with Office 365, Active Directory, and Okta" but publishes no pricing and no provisioning details; the help centre and developer portal are behind a customer login.
row.notes: New row. Building Engines (acquired by JLL) now sells Prism by Building Engines. buildingengines.com returned Akamai 403 to curl, WebFetch and the headless renderer (ERR_TOO_MANY_RETRIES), so its pricing, security and integration pages could not be read; the JLL product page was used instead and shows no prices (Get started / contact). support., help., developer. and api.buildingengines.com all land on a Building Engines login page, so SCIM or API docs, if any, are not public. SSO with Office 365, Active Directory and Okta is claimed; the Okta OIN app is SWA (password vaulting) only. SCIM availability is undisclosed, so status is unknown.

user_api.notes: developer.buildingengines.com and api.buildingengines.com require a login.

okta.notes: OIN page marks only SWA (no SAML, OIDC or SCIM checked); last updated Dec. 11 2015.
